# Python dependencies of the Antigravity workers: gemini_worker.py (the agent behind the `antigravity-worker`
# adapter) and typist_worker.py (its typist). verify-setup.mjs (/mmo:setup) installs them into a fresh
# worker/.venv with
#
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes --no-deps -r requirements.txt
#
# Locked: google-antigravity and every package it installs are pinned to the versions of the environment this
# engine's Antigravity behaviour was measured on, each with the sha256 of every file PyPI publishes for that version,
# so every install runs the same code. Where a pinned version cannot install, the line before it, marked for that
# environment, holds the nearest version that can: six packages need Python 3.11 or newer at their pinned versions
# (Python 3.10 takes the earlier ones, and exceptiongroup), and cryptography 50.0.2 publishes no macOS Intel wheel.
#
# The SDK pin. The SDK has changed what its usage totals mean between releases (0.1.9 counts cached input inside
# prompt_token_count; 0.1.16 counts it on top), and the costs this plugin reports are exact only for versions checked
# against Google's own token counter: see AGY_USAGE_SEMANTICS in src/delegation/workerProcess.ts. A version not
# listed there is billed on the larger reading (never under-reported), named in pre-flight's warnings, and logged as
# agsdk.usage_semantics_unverified. Pre-flight stops a run whose worker environment holds a version other than this
# pin; /mmo:setup rebuilds the environment at it.
#
# Moving the pin: resolve the new version's closure in a fresh environment, replace the pins and hashes here (the
# hashes from PyPI's JSON API: https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json), run the worker tests, and add the version
# to AGY_USAGE_SEMANTICS only once its usage reading has been checked.
#
# Requires Python >= 3.10. macOS ships /usr/bin/python3 as 3.9; verify-setup.mjs resolves an explicit >= 3.10
# interpreter by version-suffixed name (python3.13, python3.12, ...) rather than trusting bare `python3`.
#
# Homebrew wrinkle: some Homebrew Python builds link `pyexpat` against a libexpat that is not installed. If
# `import google.antigravity` fails with an expat error:
#
#   brew install expat
#   export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/expat/lib
